title: Archer Crimson (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: The archer in a crimson faction gambeson.

title: Archer (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Longbow archer in a padded gambeson and bascinet, bow raised in the left hand with a back quiver of arrows.

title: Iron Bound Gate Bay 4 m (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Gate bay on the wall grid: an arched tunnel, two iron bound oak leaves on their hinges and a drawbar that slides into the wall socket.

title: Assault Wall Bay 4 m (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Four metre limestone wall bay with a battered plinth, a buttress, arrow loops and a crenellated wall head over a 1.4 m walk.

title: Assault Wall Bay Breached (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: The 4 m bay opened by a breach: two jagged stubs, a rubble ramp through the gap and fallen ashlar on both faces.

title: Assault Wall Bay Cracked (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: The same 4 m bay after a stone strike: a stepped crack through the face, a shattered merlon and spalled blocks at the foot.

title: Banner Bearer Crimson (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: The banner bearer under a crimson field.

title: Banner Bearer (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Standard bearer carrying a three and a half metre banner pole with a swallow-tailed field and a charge.

title: Bell Tent Open (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: The bell tent with its flap tied back, a straw pallet and a kit chest inside.

title: Bell Tent (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Four man conical bell tent on a centre pole with six guy ropes, a pennant and a door flap that swings.

title: Bore Shelter (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Low hide-roofed shelter on skids with an iron pick bore through the front, for working stone out of a wall foot.

title: Brattice Box (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Small timber brattice on two corbel beams: a covered box that oversails a wall face with a floor slot and a front loophole.

title: Camp Palisade Corner (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Right angle corner for the camp palisade, with a taller corner stake, turning the run through ninety degrees.

title: Camp Palisade Gate (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Gate bay in the camp palisade: a two metre clear opening between braced gateposts under a lintel and a banner.

title: Camp Palisade 3 m (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Three metre run of sharpened stakes driven into an earth bank, with two rear crossrails, on the 3 m camp grid.

title: Carriage Springald (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Bolt-shooting springald on a wheeled carriage, with twisted skein boxes, a windlass slider, a loaded bolt and a pavise front.

title: Castle Wall Under Assault (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Forty metres of defended curtain on the 4 m wall grid, with a barred gate, a cracked bay and an open breach in it. Timber hoardings bracket the wall head in two runs, defenders work the merlons over a pitch cauldron, braziers and stocked arrows, and a repair scaffold stands...

title: Camp Cook Fire (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Iron tripod and cauldron over a ringed fire, with a log bench, a water butt and a stack of split wood.

title: Counterweight Trebuchet (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Six metre counterweight trebuchet on a timber bed, with a rocking throwing arm, a hinged stone counterweight box and a windlass.

title: Counterweight Trebuchet Armed (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: The trebuchet wound down and loaded: long arm at the ground, counterweight raised, sling laid out ready to loose.

title: Counterweight Trebuchet Loosed (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: The trebuchet just after release: arm swung over the frame, counterweight dropped, sling empty.

title: Crossbowman (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Crossbowman spanning a windlass crossbow, with a bolt quiver at the belt and a pavise slung on the back.

title: Defender at the Merlon (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Defender leaning out over a parapet with a crossbow, posed to sit against a merlon on a wall walk.

title: Defender Hurling a Stone (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Defender at full stretch heaving a block over a parapet, both arms above the head.

title: Dressed Shot Stack (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Graded pyramid of dressed stone shot in a timber kerb, with a mason roughing out a blank beside it.

title: Fascine Bundle Stack (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Six lashed brushwood fascines stacked in a cradle, the ditch filling and revetting a siege runs on.

title: Gabion Basket (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Woven wicker basket rammed with earth, the portable cover a siege line is built from.

title: Gabion Battery (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Five gabions in a curved line with a second course and three fascines, the finished cover for an engine position.

title: Hooked Scaling Ladder Long (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: The eight and a half metre reach of the same hooked ladder, for a high curtain or a wall on a bank.

title: Hooked Scaling Ladder (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Six and a half metre scaling ladder with iron top hooks that bite a parapet, an iron foot shoe and spiked heels.

title: Ladder Climber (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Attacker climbing at about seventy degrees, shield over the head, posed to sit on a scaling ladder.

title: Machicolation Course (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Corbelled stone course for a wall head over a gate: five brackets, four drop openings and a crenellated parapet above.

title: Man at Arms Green (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: The man at arms in a green surcoat and shield.

title: Man at Arms Crimson (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: The man at arms in a crimson surcoat and shield.

title: Man at Arms (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Armoured man at arms in a great helm, sword raised, heater shield forward over a mail hauberk and surcoat.

title: Wheeled Mantlet Screen Wide (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: The two and a half metre mantlet with three hinged loopholes, for screening an engine crew rather than one shooter.

title: Arrow and Bolt Stock (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Wall-head stock rack: two open bins of crossbow bolts, four standing sheaves of arrows and a rack of spare bowstaves.

title: Mounted Knight (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Knight on a caparisoned war horse, lance couched, three and a half metres to the helm crest.

title: Parapet Brazier and Fuel (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Iron fire basket on three legs beside a fuel crib of split logs and four bundles of pitched faggots.

title: Parapet Hoarding 4 m (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Bracketed timber fighting gallery for a wall head, with two drop shutters that lift on their top hinges and a shingled pent roof.

title: Peasant Levy (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Levy in a hood and jerkin with a billhook and a wicker shield, no mail, the cheapest body on a siege line.

title: Pitch Cauldron on a Tripod (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Iron cauldron of boiling pitch swinging on trunnions in a tripod, over a fire crib, with a tipping clip.

title: Winched Portcullis (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Stone gate frame with a spiked iron portcullis that lifts 2.5 m in its slots, over a squared winch drum on brackets.

title: Wall Repair Scaffold and Hoist (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Two-lift timber scaffold with a braced jib, a turning hoist drum, a stone skip and a mortar tub for repairing a breach.

title: Breach Rubble Pile (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Loose spill of fallen ashlar, broken limestone and mortar dust to fill and dress the foot of a breach.

title: Siege Camp Standard (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Five metre guyed standard mast over a trophy pile of taken arms, marking the besiegers headquarters.

title: Siege Command Pavilion (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Round guyed marquee with a scalloped valance, a swinging door flap, a centre pole pennant and a map table under the eaves.

title: Siege Crew Engineer (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Engine crewman in a leather apron with a mallet and a measuring rod, no armour, reading as a worker not a soldier.

title: Siege Hand Cart (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Two-wheel hand cart with shafts down, loaded with dressed shot, a cask and lashed fascines; the wheels roll.

title: Battering Ram Penthouse (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Six metre wheeled penthouse over a slung ram beam with an iron head; the beam swings on its slings and six wheels roll.

title: Siege Tower Three Stage (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: The taller three-stage belfry for a high curtain, at eight metres to the bridge hinge, on the same six-wheel chassis.

title: Siege Tower (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Two-stage boarded siege tower on six wheels, with hide facing, an internal ladder and a drop bridge that falls onto a parapet.

title: Spearman Green (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: The spearman in a green faction surcoat and shield.

title: Spearman Crimson (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: The spearman in a crimson faction surcoat and shield.

title: Spearman (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Levy spearman in a kettle hat and surcoat, spear grounded at the ready with a heater shield on the left arm.

title: Lashed Supply Stack (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Crates and casks stacked on a dunnage pallet under a tarpaulin, roped down against the weather.

title: Traction Mangonel (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Wheeled traction mangonel: a rocking throwing arm with a bowl, a padded crossbeam stop and four solid wheels that roll.

title: Wheeled Mantlet Screen (Medieval Siege and Castle Defence)
summary: Man-high wheeled plank screen with a hinged loophole shutter, a straw padded head and a prop leg; the wheels roll.
